learning_outcomes.text: work together in an interdisciplinary and intercultural team
bring together knowledge and methods from their own discipline with those from other disciplines and relate them to social contexts
plan and carry out smaller projects
include psychological aspects in their communication
design contemporary journalistic formats for science communication
conduct discourses and negotiate democratic decisions using rhetorical means

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of communication, change management, science journalism and rhetoric
Planning and execution of a project (with reference to sustainability and current social issues)
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful project presentation and project implementation.
